production.note: 18 mission-only stills for the rebuilt Unit 5 mission: a kickoff, nine listening scenes and the question and response views of four voice gates. The stub mission's market, register and café scenes cannot be kept, because the approved photo-edit record for each one pins its stub card exactly as inspected, so the rebuilt beats bind their own stills and the stub scenes are retired with evidence. The kickoff fixes the market and café cast, and every later scene with people is generated from it. No automatic retries. The first café-counter attempt was rejected after the cue check: its fourth customer held a cup, so the only natural line for him was "Thank you.", which the learner cannot tell apart from "No, thank you." on the same board. The replacement has him ordering tea instead; the rejected attempt stays in the ledger.

shared_prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create a brand-new high-detail real photograph for a beginner English learning game, full-bleed 3:2 landscape. Natural material textures, believable optics, physically coherent light, realistic skin, anatomy and hands. This is one continuous real scene, not a collage, infographic, illustration, split-screen, panels, toy model or app screenshot. When several targets are requested they must be visually distinct at phone size, well separated left to right, with clear empty space above each target for UI markers added later, and they must never touch or overlap each other. Do not draw dots, arrows, labels, UI, speech bubbles, borders, captions or watermarks. Preserve full people including feet when visible; no cropped heads, hands or action. No padded or blurred side strips. No venue names, logos or answer words; only explicitly requested numerals may appear.

change_control.reason: Unit 5 parity mission: the kickoff shot that states the mission and fixes the faces and clothes every later scene reuses.

assets.prompt: A small neighbourhood market and café on one bright street corner, photographed straight on from across the pavement. Five ordinary people stand together in front of the open market stall, side by side and clearly separated, all facing the camera with friendly relaxed expressions: a woman in her thirties with dark hair in a bun and a mustard cardigan; a man in his forties with short grey-flecked hair, a blue shirt and a green apron, the market seller; a young woman in her twenties with long brown hair and a denim jacket; a man in his twenties with short black hair, glasses and a grey sweater; and a boy of about ten in a red t-shirt. Behind them the stall's crates of fruit and vegetables and, to the right, the café's window with its counter inside. Every face is sharp and every person is complete from head to feet. No readable words, no price tags, no logos.

assets.prompt: Use case: text-exact. Four market price tags standing in a row along a wooden stall counter, photographed straight on in daylight, evenly spaced with clear counter between them and no people at all. Each tag is a plain white card in a small metal holder and carries exactly one price in clean black handwriting. From left to right they read exactly: $1, $2, $3, $5. No decimals, no cents, no words, no other numerals anywhere in the frame, and no repeated price. Each tag is perfectly sharp, fully legible and at least 15% of the frame width, with clear empty space above it. Small goods may sit behind the tags but must stay secondary. No people, no logos.
